article.headline: Isaac Dye, Evan Boisdur help Abilene Christian hold on for 83-81 victory over Lamar
article.description: — Isaac Dye had 18 points and Evan Boisdur scored 17 to help Abilene Christian fend off Lamar 83-81 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Isaac Dye, Evan Boisdur help Abilene Christian hold on for 83-81 victory over Lamar
article.story: ABILENE, Texas -- — Isaac Dye had 18 points and Evan Boisdur scored 17 to help Abilene Christian fend off Lamar 83-81 on Saturday. Dye went 6 of 9 from the field (4 for 5 from 3-point range) for the Wildcats (1-1). Boisdur added seven assists. Timeo Pons scored 15. Quante Berry finished with 20 points for the Cardinals (1-1). Dominic Eason added 17 points and Mike Collins scored 13. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
